title: Figures 17-18: Qu Supertube temperature distribution plot and 10 ft test apparatus photo
description: Reproduced journal page on the Qu Tube ("Supertube"). Figure 17 is a line plot of temperature distribution along tube length comparing Supertube data with copper tube and rod predictions; caption: "Figure 17. Comparison of Essentially Constant Supertube Temperature Distribution with Theoretical Distribution for a Standard Copper Tube and Rod, Showing that the Thermal Conductivity Must be at Least 30,000 Times that of Copper." Figure 18 is a color photograph of a long tube on an inclined wooden test frame in a lab; caption: "Figure 18. Experimental Apparatus for 10 ft Qu Supertubes."
